description: Host unpacks an OCI layer package and finds the skill at its contribution path.

input.scenario: Catalog with one entry of mediaType application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip whose archive holds skills/take-notes/SKILL.md; contribution kind skill, path skills/take-notes. Bytes match size and contentHash.

expect.behaviour: The host unpacks the archive into an empty package root, finds skills/take-notes/SKILL.md and the entry reaches prepared.
